sources.title: TypeSafe AI: System One Models + Jev (Sep 15)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: TypeSafe AI Sep 15 releases System One Models + Jev (early access): new frontier model class for fast structured decisions software uses directly; new architecture + parallel sampler + Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions (RLCD); unstructured state in, typed probabilistic decisions out (Noul/Choice/Score primitives).
claims.context: Founder post lede and positioning as stated.

claims.text: Jev: comparable intelligence on System One tasks vs LLMs at ~2 orders of magnitude efficiency; 70-500ms end-to-end (40-200x); $0.042/MTok input, outputs free; calibrated confidence; zero type errors by schema guarantee (mathematical per page); evals site + adapter repo linked; workflow-eval gains up to 193.6x/444.6x flagged on-page as higher-end with bias caveats.
claims.context: Pricing/speed/confidence sections as stated; commercial terms vendor-stated.

claims.text: Positioned for AI workflows/smart conditionals, big-data map-reduce, real-time apps, verify-everything (scoring/judging/guardrails); docs, evals, console/playground surfaces linked.
